rationale: A valid material redesign is available from the working evaluation's strongest structural recommendation. Version 3 preserves the researched candidate unchanged as the development base. Version 4 stops selling generic peer-QC access by analyzer and instead sells a white-label support-operations implementation and annual portfolio licence to a narrowly defined distributor support organization. All six fingerprint fields change, the paid unit and acquisition model change, and the economics now depend on measured support-work reduction and reusable authorized workflows. The redesign does not assume that a suitable buyer, data rights, paid demand, regulatory position, savings, price, margin, or renewal exists; each remains an explicit validation gate.
